# Edstem Technologies

> > Custom software solutions provider specializing in AI/ML engineering, cloud infrastructure, and digital transformation for enterprise clients.

Edstem Technologies is an ISO-certified software development company partnered with Protero and PwC, delivering cutting-edge solutions in cloud-native architectures, data engineering, and AI-powered automation. The company maintains a strong engineering culture focused on knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and technical excellence across AWS, Kubernetes, and modern application frameworks.

## Key Topics

- AI/ML Engineering
- AWS Cloud Infrastructure (S3, EKS)
- Kubernetes & Container Orchestration
- Digital Transformation
- Platform Modernization
- Data Engineering & Apache Kafka
- Python & Java Development
- React & Frontend Engineering
- PostgreSQL Optimization
- Zero-Downtime Deployments
- Log Management & OpenSearch
- Performance Optimization
- Mobile App Development (Flutter)
- Software Development Best Practices
- Company Culture & Team Building
